provider: NSF ACCESS / Jetstream2 object store (OpenStack Swift, S3-compatible) — 1 TB default storage per allocation

free_tier.stated: By default, all allocations receive 1 TB (1000 GB) of Jetstream2 Storage quota.

retention.notes: - 30 days from expiration: If the allocation has not been renewed *(preferred)* or extended, all resources (instances, volumes, shares, images) on the allocation will be destroyed and will not be recoverable.

egress.terms: A temporary URL (or “temp URL”) is a signed, time-limited link that lets anyone download (`GET`) or upload (`PUT`) a single object without OpenStack credentials.

tooling: 'The Jetstream2 object store utilizes OpenStack Swift and is S3 compatible. You can utilize it via Horizon or the command line interface (CLI). From the CLI, you can use the OpenStack CLI's container and object commands, the AWS CLI's s3api, or other compatible tools.' Temp-URL keys give signed GET and signed PUT for a single object.
chaining: 1 TB default per allocation, but storage is credit-purchased, so the multiplier is ACCESS credits across project types (Explore 400k / Discover 1.5M / Accelerate 3M) and multiple requests (Explore and Discover explicitly allow 'Multiple requests allowed'). A 400k-credit Explore project = 400 GB above the default if spent purely on storage. The credit exchange rate, not a per-account cap, is the ceiling.

limits.value: reviewed but not a full panel)

limits_note: per-object-cap: Swift, so large objects need segmentation; no single documented byte cap. Retention: storage is allocation-lifetime. request-rate: not published. Gate: ACCESS allocation (institutional email required; Explore is the lightest at 'Overview' requirements, reviewed but not a full panel).

identity_cost.detail: For both PIs and users, your institutional email addresses must match your institutional affiliation listed.

reliability_note: Docs state plainly 'Jetstream2 is not primarily a storage service; large-capacity storage is beyond the scope of Jetstream2'. Treat as a 1-50 TB tier, not an archive.
confidence_note: the quotas page states the default 1 TB storage quota per allocation
